title: Image still pins claude CLI 2.1.227: opus/sonnet resolve to 5, not 5.5
body:
6fv's title promises a current claude CLI in the image, and the operator's note on tda says the aliases resolve to 5.5 today. CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION is still 2.1.227, which maps opus to claude-opus-5 and sonnet to claude-sonnet-5. The weekly workflow only proposes a bump later.
evidence: image/Dockerfile:53 ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.227; docs/spikes/jvj-claude-sub-cloud.md design item 1
